heroSubtitle: Lasuarindo Group presents an integrated business ecosystem driving growth, innovation, and real impact across Indonesia's strategic sectors.

intro.heading: Six Business Lines, One Ecosystem
intro.body: Lasuarindo Group invests in, owns, and manages businesses across six business lines, from investment and property to technology, media, F&B, and lifestyle. We develop each unit within one group business ecosystem.

sectorDetailsLead: These six sectors make up the group portfolio. Each sector has units carrying out day-to-day work in our district.
sectorsDesc: Our portfolio is made up of six business sectors. Each has its own role and contributes to the group ecosystem as a whole.

sectorEnrichment.note: The editorial narrative and the unit names, descriptions, and capabilities below are drawn from temporary group ecosystem data and await company verification.

investment.subtitle: Business ownership within one group portfolio
investment.lead: Lasuarindo Group places investment and business ownership in a single group portfolio. The role is part of the group business ecosystem.
investment.body: Its work centres on strategic investments and asset management recorded in the group portfolio.

property.subtitle: Workspaces, facilities, and district management
property.lead: The property line brings together district planning, development, and facility management. The work takes place within the group business district.
property.body: The work covers district and facility management, working and creative spaces, and parking and valet services.

technology.subtitle: Product verification and copyright protection
technology.lead: Technology in the group is directed at product protection and copyright. Both are part of the group's technology portfolio.
technology.body: The work covers digital verification for product protection, brand protection, and copyright protection for musicians and songwriters.

media.subtitle: Online media, content production, and outdoor media
media.lead: The media & creative line covers three functions: online media, content production, and outdoor media. They serve the group's communication needs.
media.body: The work covers news portals and online media, visual and audio content production, and billboards, vidiotrons, and branding in the district.

food.subtitle: Food court, café, and consumer products
food.lead: The F&B & consumer portfolio brings together food venues and consumer products within the group ecosystem. It is part of the group portfolio.
food.body: The work covers food court and culinary tenant management, café operations, mie yamin service, and perfume product development.

lifestyle.subtitle: Sport, personal care, and entertainment in the group district
lifestyle.lead: The lifestyle & entertainment line covers padel, personal care, and mahjong entertainment. All three sit within the group business district.
lifestyle.body: The work covers padel courts and community events, beauty and personal care services, and membership-based mahjong entertainment.

propertyScope: Its scope covers residential district planning, design and construction, and property management. District and facility development is carried out with WIN, Bizencio, and SAA.
mediaScope: Its scope covers news portals and social media (MSS), film, video, music, and advertising production (Arcadia Segara Cita), as well as billboards, vidiotrons, and branding (Berkah Media Gemilang).
techScope: Its scope covers digital verification for product protection through AGT/Authentic Guards, and copyright protection for musicians and songwriters through Berkah Megah Abadi.

techDesc: Lasuarindo Group builds a strong digital foundation through cutting-edge technology services. From software development to cloud infrastructure, we deliver smart, secure, and sustainable solutions to drive your business digital transformation.
